singleSourced.value: Perceive those things, which cannot be seen,
singleSourced.context: "Perceive those things, which cannot be seen," advises Musashi in his book - something Capcom probably took a bit too literally when it gave you a 'Press R2 to see into the demon realm' button that highlights objectives and the critical path for you.
When you spent two years negotiating the rights to a dead man's face because he's "the quintessential samurai action actor", you're going to want to make sure you do right by him.
If you want to "become acquainted with every art" and "pay attention even to trifles", though, you're looking at something closer to 30.
